keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Argentina 1, Costa Rica 0. Nico Paz (Argentina) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Enzo Fernández.
Goal! Argentina 2, Costa Rica 0. Julián Alvarez (Argentina) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Agustín Giay.
Goal! Argentina 3, Costa Rica 0. Nico Paz (Argentina) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Máximo Perrone.
Goal! Argentina 4, Costa Rica 0. Julián Alvarez (Argentina) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the top left corner. Assisted by Gianluca Prestianni.
First Half ends, Argentina 4, Costa Rica 0.
Substitution, Costa Rica. John Ruiz replaces Aarón Salazar.
Substitution, Costa Rica. Josimar Alcócer replaces Kenyel Michel.
Substitution, Argentina. Franco Mastantuono replaces Nico Paz.
Substitution, Argentina. Gonzalo Montiel replaces Agustín Giay.
Substitution, Argentina. José Manuel López replaces Julián Alvarez.
Substitution, Costa Rica. Douglas López replaces Andrey Soto.
Second Half begins Argentina 4, Costa Rica 0.
Goal! Argentina 5, Costa Rica 0. Franco Mastantuono (Argentina) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Máximo Perrone.
Substitution, Costa Rica. Kenay Myrie replaces Josimar Méndez.
Substitution, Argentina. Thiago Almada replaces Enzo Fernández.
Substitution, Argentina. Mariano Troilo replaces Lisandro Martínez.
Substitution, Argentina. Nicolás Tagliafico replaces Román Vega.
Substitution, Costa Rica. Joseph Mora replaces Carlos Mora.
Substitution, Costa Rica. Gabriel Leiva replaces Celso Borges.
Substitution, Argentina. Giuliano Simeone replaces Gianluca Prestianni.
Substitution, Argentina. Aaron Anselmino replaces Facundo Medina.
Substitution, Costa Rica. Gian Morera replaces Manfred Ugalde.
Goal! Argentina 6, Costa Rica 0. Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Argentina 7, Costa Rica 0. Franco Mastantuono (Argentina) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Giuliano Simeone.
Second Half ends, Argentina 7, Costa Rica 0.
